skills.name: ping-quickstart
skills.description: Front door for all Ping Identity work. Orients users in the Ping ecosystem — which platform to use, where to start, ForgeRock migration paths, and cross-cutting end-to-end validation.

skills.name: ping-foundation
skills.description: Platform setup, administration, and core configuration for PingOne MT, PingOne ST (AIC), PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, and PingID. Covers tenant setup, app registration, directories, policies, and branding.

skills.name: ping-orchestration
skills.description: Design and build authentication flows, journeys, and orchestration logic across DaVinci (PingOne MT), AIC/PingAM journeys (PingOne ST), and PingFederate authentication policies.

skills.name: ping-universal-services
skills.description: Configure and invoke Ping Universal Services — PingOne Protect (risk), PingOne Verify (KYC), PingOne Credentials, PingOne IGA (governance), and PingOne Authorize — from DaVinci flows or AIC journeys.

skills.name: ping-app-integration
skills.description: Integrate Ping Identity into web, mobile, and server-side applications. Covers Android, iOS, React, and JavaScript SDK integration; backend OIDC/OAuth patterns; on-prem agent integration; and ForgeRock SDK migration.

skills.name: ping-identity-for-ai
skills.description: AI-era identity patterns: agent identity registration, machine-to-machine auth, Verified Trust signals, CIBA human-in-the-loop, bot detection, PingGateway MCP protection, and Ping Identity for AI 5-pillar architecture.
